description: This file implements the ISO639 language code lookup and search functions within the Thunder::Core namespace. It defines a static lookup table of language entries and provides methods to find languages by code or ID.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Class providing language code lookup and search functionalities.

methods.name: FindLanguage(const TCHAR*, uint32_t)
methods.description: Finds a language entry based on a language code string, supporting 2 or 3 character codes.

methods.name: FindLanguage(const uint16_t)
methods.description: Finds a language entry based on a numeric ID.
